items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Don Lamond was on the band at that time instead of Davy Tough... And I came in on my high C

ctx.x: I guess that was pretty difficult, right? I mean you were playing shows?

Yeah it was difficult. Well I’ll tell you, it was difficult to play it correctly because playing it correctly I mean playing it with a certain finesse that’s required, but not hitting double D flats on the trumpet. You know I’m screaming above the band, six and eight shows a weekend at the Paramount. That is not conducive to playing delicate and with finesses. And the one part opens up with the woodwinds I guess, now this is Woody’s band [scats]. Then the fugue starts in. And at one point he had [scats] on…
On your high C. Oh God.
